an10.119:1.1: Tena kho pana samayena Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo tadah' uposathe sīsaṃ nahāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya Bhagavato avidūre ekamantaṃ ṭhito hoti.
an10.119:2.1: Addasā kho Bhagavā Jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tadah' uposathe sīsaṃ nahātaṃ navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthaṃ allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya avidūre ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ,
an10.119:2.3: ‘kin nu kho tvaṃ brāhmaṇa tadah' uposathe sīsaṃ nahāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhito,
an10.119:2.4: kin nu kho ajja brāhmaṇakulassā' ti?
an10.119:3.1: Yathākathaṃ pana brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotī' ti?
an10.119:3.2: ‘Idha bho Gotama brāhmaṇā tadah' uposathe sīsaṃ nahātā navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthā allena gomayena paṭhaviṃ opuñjitvā haritehi kusehi pattharitvā antarā ca velaṃ antarā ca agyāgāraṃ seyyaṃ kappenti.
an10.119:3.3: Te taṃ rattiṃ tikkhattuṃ paccuṭṭhāya pañjalikā aggiṃ namassanti
an10.119:3.5: pahutena ca sappitelena navanītena aggiṃ santappenti,
an10.119:3.6: tassā ca rattiyā accayena paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena brāhmaṇe santappenti.
an10.119:3.7: Evaṃ bho Gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hoti' ti.
an10.119:4.1: ‘Aññathā kho brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī' ti.
an10.119:4.2: ‘Yathākathaṃ pana bho Gotama ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hoti?
an10.119:4.3: Sādhu me bhavaṃ Gotama tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathā ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī' ti.
an10.119:5.1: ‘Tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an10.119:5.2: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo Bhagavato paccassosi.

an10.119:16.1: Aññathā bho Gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hoti,
an10.119:16.2: imissā ca bho Gotama ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇiyā brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an10.119:16.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotama dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇagatan ti. 1.
